name: Hades Izanami
source:
Hobbies: Jigsaw puzzles
Likes: World
Dislikes: [url=/c25638]Ragna the Bloodedge[/url]

Hades Izanami is the main antagonist of the BlazBlue series, and the Imperator of the Novus Orbis Librarium. She is also a playable character in Central Fiction.
She is an immortal being, death incarnate. She is using [url=/c39474]Saya[/url] as a vessel. Her goal is to reduce everything in the universe to nothing. She appears to have a feud with [url=/c25640]Rachel Alucard[/url].

Hades Izanami is devoid of all emotion and extremely literal-minded. She is obsessed with making the world die and will stop at nothing to accomplish her goal. The Goddess remarks that she can "feel" the strong attachment that the real Saya has towards Ragna. Throughout the game, she constantly mocks Ragna with Saya's voice in a playful manner. She is also shown to have little to no concern for her comrades, even to the point of offering Ragna Terumi's head in exchange for joining her side and eventually discarding both Terumi and [url=/c26279]Relius[/url] when they were of no further use to her. In addition, she has no true attachment to her title and announces to the entire world that she willingly hands the role of Imperator to Homura and would grant the "gift" of death to the world. She, like Relius, has a dislike of [url=/c20688]Hazama[/url] and his "playful" attitude, though it also could be out of Saya's proxy due to what Terumi did to her in the past.

[spoiler]Izanami is actually a living doll crafted by Relius, and the manifestation of the true Noel's Drive.[/spoiler]
